items.label: HYDRA · Ender-3 source parts
items.source_version: Printables files 2022-04-13; base STEP 2021-08-04; tool plate STEP v1
items.notes: Manual tool-plate system. Individual printed parts only; fans, hotend, extruder, fasteners and probes are absent. Ender-3 installation is not registered. Five 0.2 mm nut-hole support membranes are removed from the base parts.
